question: What happens to the body and experience when the vital breath breaks apart?
premises: The vital breath can become disjoined from its normal functioning.
When the breath breaks apart, the body appears as inert matter.
A new sphere of experience arises according to the sequence of prior latent impressions.
inference: At the disruption of the vital breath, the body falls into inert appearance and consciousness passes into another experiential domain shaped by prior impressions.
uncertainties: The exact scope of adhikāra here, whether a new life-domain or a new experiential jurisdiction, is context-dependent.
plain_english: When the vital breath breaks apart, the body appears inert, and one passes into another sphere of experience that arises according to the sequence of earlier latent impressions.
